title: Template:2Players/doc
wikitext:
This template outputs one flag, then two (or only one) linked players. If there's 2 players, they're separated by a blue "&".
==2 players== The following code: 
{{2Players|usca|BLooD_DoG|BogoJoker}}
Gives us: {{2Players|usca|BLooD_DoG|BogoJoker}} ==1 player (or team)== This gives same output as {{Tl|Player}}, but other templates (Infobox league) use this to be able to display either or.
The following code: 
{{2Players|usca|Clan Unf!|}}
Gives us: {{2Players|usca|Clan Unf!|}} ==Use== * First value is flag, leave empty for {{Flag/tbd}} * Second value is player1 * Third value is player2 ** If both second and third values are empty, it will display as {{2Players|usca||}}
